The '''R1 security droid'''<ref name="Droids Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Assassin, Security, and Other Droids of War}}</ref> was a model of [[security droid|security]] Republic that was utilized by the [[New Republic Correctional Corps]] which bore a resemblance to the [[R1-series astromech droid]], albeit outfitted with [[Blaster|blasters]] to better suit its role. At least two units of this droid were deployed to a [[New Republic Correctional Transport]], the ''[[Bothan-5]],'' where they were used to patrol the vessel, until they were encountered by a crew of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] attempting to [[Bothan-Five incident|rescue]] a [[Twi'lek]] [[prisoner]] named [[Qin]]. One of the mercenaries, a [[Devaronian]] named [[Burg]], attacked the droids severely damaging one before throwing it into the other, causing an explosion which destroyed both units.<ref name="Chapter 6" />
